summary: Replace F-screen SVM plan: diagnose screens (F vs RF-importance vs MI) on pilot only
reasoning: The tuning run (observation step-9) contradicted the plan: fully nested CV of F-screen + RBF SVM gives cv_auc 0.673 (< 0.71 expected) and logreg on the same screen 0.573, while the established screened-forest sits at 0.7267 — so the marginal F-statistic screen is the bottleneck for a kernel model; the SVM needs features chosen for joint usefulness. New pilot-only plan: (a) calibrate my harness by re-running the snapshot's nested forest (expect ~0.72), (b) compare F vs random-forest-importance vs MI screens inside folds with a small SVM grid (plus an all-500-feature point for information), writing the best pilot-side cv to out/metrics.json as cv_auc with its n_features. Expectation: some screen reaches pilot CV >= 0.72, which is the loose bar for proceeding to a full repeated-nested retune; n_features must stay <= 50. All of this reads only data/pilot.csv.
